blog_title: Premium Polo T-Shirt Colors for Bulk Printing — 8 New Shades We Added After Losing a Big Order
caption:
A customer offered ₹2 lakh to make shirts. We said no 🤔

Why? Shirts need woven fabric + tailoring. T-shirts need circular knit + bio-wash. Completely different machines, workers, quality checks. We maintain 1 lakh ready t-shirt pieces — chasing shirts would tank our core product quality.

The lesson: staying focused beats chasing every rupee.

Save this if you're scaling your printing business 👇
